title: Anton Paar
content: Anton Paar is an Austrian instrumentation company supplying measurement and analysis systems used in advanced materials research and quality control. Its gas adsorption and porosity analyzers are relevant to aerogel characterization workflows, including BET surface area measurement and pore structure analysis. Anton Paar equipment is widely used in laboratories that need reliable data on porous materials, powders, and insulation-related material performance.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
